entities.summary: Jamia Tur Rasheed, Karachi is an Islamic seminary in Karachi, Pakistan. The seminary was established by Rasheed Ahmad Ludhianvi. It is a degree awarding institute accredited by Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training and the Higher Education Commission.
